release.notes: Added a compact Exam Results register with search, section and scanning-status filters, pagination and separate score, unscanned learner, summary and analysis tabs. Added personal no-record slip image, PNG and text actions beside Print. Activity follow-up images now include category and a submission reminder, using configured deadlines for late-submission wording. Includes the score mouse-wheel protection from the previous release. Existing records, settings and activation are preserved.
